# PM012: cycle-member-not-ready

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | PM |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | advisory |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A not-yet-started member of an open or planned cycle fails the definition of ready.

Advisory. The predicates are `[pm] ready_requires`; the finding names the
failed ones. Started and finished members are not judged.

## Remedy

Complete the ticket (`frob ticket update TICKET` to add points, scope,
criteria or a parent), or move it out of the cycle with `frob cycle
unassign TICKET`.

## Examples

### PM012 cycle member that is not ready / A member missing points fires naming the predicate #1 (line 10) (fire)

```text
ready_requires points
task a
cycle c start=-1 end=5 members=a
```

### PM012 cycle member that is not ready / A member meeting every required predicate is clean #2 (line 18) (clean)

```text
ready_requires points,scope,criteria
task a points=3 scope=src/** criteria=1
cycle c start=-1 end=5 members=a
```

### PM012 cycle member that is not ready / A story without a value statement fires #3 (line 26) (fire)

```text
ready_requires story_or_objective_qualified
story s value=none
cycle c start=-1 end=5 members=s
```

### PM012 cycle member that is not ready / A story with a value statement is clean #4 (line 34) (clean)

```text
ready_requires story_or_objective_qualified
story s
cycle c start=-1 end=5 members=s
```

### PM012 cycle member that is not ready / A member without a parent fires under the default requirements #5 (line 42) (fire)

```text
task a points=3 scope=src/** criteria=1
cycle c start=-1 end=5 members=a
```

### PM012 cycle member that is not ready / A member that is already in progress is not judged #6 (line 49) (clean)

```text
ready_requires points
task a state=in_progress
cycle c start=-1 end=5 members=a
```

### PM012 cycle member that is not ready / A closed cycle is not judged #7 (line 57) (clean)

```text

```
